title: Design System: NBA 拍賣選秀板 · 戰術板

title.purpose: Title tape in the top rail (22px ≥760px).

printed-label.purpose: Printed headings (.ph) in print-ink over a 1.5px print rule.

column-head.purpose: Printed column heads of the wall, league board and roster.

print-number.purpose: Rank numbers, league W–L; index is 24px.

print-label-latin.purpose: Latin category heads, positions, heat labels.

marker-record.purpose: Weekly W–L in the tally (50px in a ≤460px container).

marker-cell.purpose: Nine rank numbers on my board.

shadows.name: magnet-rest
shadows.purpose: Strips, keys, chips, round magnets, segment control. Night: 0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.5), 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.35).

shadows.name: magnet-lift
shadows.purpose: Hover, checked trade strip, lift and snap keyframes. Night: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.55), 0 12px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.45).

shadows.name: magnet-thickness
shadows.purpose: Every name magnet and trade strip; tape-mine-side on mine.

shadows.name: tape
shadows.purpose: Label tape, with a laminate sheen linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.5), transparent 45%).

shadows.name: taped-sheet
shadows.purpose: The method sheet, held by two clear tape strips.

shadows.name: pen-groove
shadows.purpose: The recessed groove holding the pens.

shadows.name: frame-on-wall
shadows.purpose: The board hanging on the wall at ≥1520px.

motion.name: marker-stroke
motion.purpose: Rings, ticks, verdict underline, lane arrow; drawn once per data change.

motion.name: lift
motion.purpose: A magnet newly placed on the trade lane.

motion.name: snap
motion.purpose: Received players snap onto my roster after 套用; row tint cleared after 900ms.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Keys, chips, trade strips; checked strip translateY(-2px) rotate(-.5deg).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No transitions or animations; marks shown drawn, magnets placed instantly.

breakpoints.name: tray-tight
breakpoints.value: max-width: 480px (season hidden, pens tighten); 430px (W–L hidden in tray); 340px

breakpoints.name: two-column
breakpoints.value: min-width: 1100px (my board + roster | league + 我碰到各隊; gutter 28px)

breakpoints.name: wall
breakpoints.value: min-width: 1520px (board hangs on the locker-room wall)

breakpoints.name: container-wall
breakpoints.value: pl ≤979px heat to third row; ≤640px phone row layout

breakpoints.name: container-league
breakpoints.value: lg ≤720px tiles on own row; ≥480px / ≥760px roster in 2 / 3 columns

breakpoints.name: container-trade
breakpoints.value: tr ≥1040px four-column board with court; ≥900px suggestions in two columns; ≤600px one column

darkMode.persist: localStorage nba-auction-theme (auto / light / dark), applied before first paint
darkMode.note: Black glass board with liquid-chalk inks; label tape stays light with dark tape ink; tile text flips to light except the two ends (#0B1A33 / #2A0B08).

narrative.overview:
The page is the manager's locker-room tactics whiteboard. Cool white melamine sits in an aluminium frame: side rails at every width, black corner caps at the top and at the ends of the marker tray, and at very wide screens the whole board hangs on a locker-room wall. The model's numbers are printed on the board in board blue: ruled grids, column heads, a faint court behind the trade magnets. Every player and team name sits on a flat magnet strip with a visible thickness edge, and headings are laminated label tape. The coach's dry-erase marker does the judging: a circled rank, the week's win–loss written large, the money in green or red, red rings around weak category ranks, blue ticks on strong ones, a drawn double arrow between traded magnets. A faint, half-erased old play shows behind my board.

Density is a working board, not a dashboard. The wall of about 240 players and the 14-team league board are ruled rails with one row per name, and every column is printed once at the top. Night is the black glass board with liquid-chalk inks; the material stays the same and only the surfaces and inks change.

Confirmed rejections, from the direction contract: the category default of a dark sports-analytics dashboard (KPI tiles, neon accents, player headshots), and its opposite, a plain white spreadsheet.
keyCharacteristics: Melamine board in an aluminium frame with black corner caps, at every width; a sticky marker tray at the bottom holds the jump links as marker pens.
Printed parts are board-blue lines with no fill; names are magnet strips; headings are label tape (yellow for my team).
Four marker inks only: black, blue (strong), red (weak or losing), green (money or winning).
Category ranks and per-player heat are square magnet tiles on a blue-to-red scale.
Noto Sans TC for all Chinese, Sofia Sans Condensed with tabular figures for printed numbers, Kalam for the marker's digits and Latin only.
Motion is lifting, snapping and marker strokes; all of it is static under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Four Inks Rule
rules.body: Anything handwritten or judged is one of four marker inks: black (neutral), blue (strong), red (weak or losing), green (money or winning). There is no fifth ink, no neon, and no other accent; yellow is tape, never ink.

rules.name: The Printed Board Rule
rules.body: Printed parts (the tally, the nine-rank grid, the trade result box, printed headings, column heads, the court) are `print` lines with no fill. Never turn them into filled cards.

rules.name: The Yellow Is Mine Rule
rules.body: Yellow tape, yellow magnets and the yellow tint belong to my team only.

rules.name: The No Chinese Handwriting Rule
rules.body: Kalam writes digits, `#`, `$`, `+ −` and Latin only. No Traditional Chinese marker face exists, so Chinese is always Noto Sans TC, even inside a marker line (週 in `+$142/週` falls back to Noto).

rules.name: The Tabular Print Rule
rules.body: Every printed number is Sofia Sans Condensed with `tabular-nums`, so columns of figures line up.

rules.name: The Fixed Track Rule
rules.body: Every row of the wall is its own grid, so every track is a fixed width except the single `minmax(0, 1fr)` name track. Never use `auto` tracks there; they would size per row and break the column alignment.

rules.name: The Ruled Rail Rule
rules.body: The wall, my roster and the league rosters are ruled rails: one bordered list with 1px `print-2` rules between rows and no gaps. Never split them into separate cards.

rules.name: The Magnet Thickness Rule
rules.body: A name magnet always shows its thickness: a 2.5px `strip-side` bottom edge (`tape-mine-side` on mine). Printed parts never get a shadow or an edge.

dos: **Do** keep the aluminium side rails and black corner caps at every width, and the sticky marker tray with 交易 as the one blue primary pen.
**Do** use only the four marker inks: black, blue for strong, red for weak or losing, green for money or winning.
**Do** draw printed parts as `print` board-blue lines with no fill.
**Do** put every player and team name on a magnet strip with its 2.5px thickness edge, yellow for mine.
**Do** keep the wall, my roster and the league rosters as ruled rails with 1px `print-2` rules and no gaps.
**Do** give every wall track a fixed width except the one `minmax(0, 1fr)` name track, so columns align across rows.
**Do** set Chinese in Noto Sans TC, printed numbers in Sofia Sans Condensed with tabular figures, and only digits and Latin in Kalam.
**Do** keep motion to lifting, snapping and marker strokes, drawn once per data change, and static under reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** build a dark analytics dashboard of KPI tiles, neon accents or player headshots, or a plain white spreadsheet.
**Don't** turn printed parts (the tally, the rank grid, the trade result, column heads) into filled cards.
**Don't** split the wall or rosters into separate cards with gaps between them.
**Don't** use `auto` grid tracks in the wall rows.
**Don't** write Chinese in the marker face, or printed figures in Kalam.
**Don't** add a fifth ink colour, or use yellow for anything that isn't mine.
**Don't** use gradients anywhere but the aluminium hardware and the label tape's sheen.
